name: Rosette
description: Prize rosettes in rows: discs of sixteen pleats in two colors with pointed edges, a button at the middle and two swallowtail ribbons hanging below.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --pi: @p(0, 1, 2, 3, 4); --qd: @p(1, 2, 3, 4); --p: @match($(pi) == 0, var(--color2), $(pi) == 1, var(--color3), $(pi) == 2, var(--color4), $(pi) == 3, var(--color5), var(--color6)); --q: @match(($(pi) + $(qd)) % 5 == 0, var(--color2), ($(pi) + $(qd)) % 5 == 1, var(--color3), ($(pi) + $(qd)) % 5 == 2, var(--color4), ($(pi) + $(qd)) % 5 == 3, var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-10, 10)deg); transform: rotate(@r(-10, 10)deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; width: 80%; top: 22%; height: 96%; background: @p(@var(--p)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--tails); clip-path: @var(--tails); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; width: 84%; top: 0; height: 84%; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--color1) 0 30%, transparent 30% 35%, @var(--q) 35% 40%, transparent 40%), conic-gradient(from -5.625deg, transparent 0deg 22.5deg, @var(--q) 22.5deg 45deg, transparent 45deg 67.5deg, @var(--q) 67.5deg 90deg, transparent 90deg 112.5deg, @var(--q) 112.5deg 135deg, transparent 135deg 157.5deg, @var(--q) 157.5deg 180deg, transparent 180deg 202.5deg, @var(--q) 202.5deg 225deg, transparent 225deg 247.5deg, @var(--q) 247.5deg 270deg, transparent 270deg 292.5deg, @var(--q) 292.5deg 315deg, transparent 315deg 337.5deg, @var(--q) 337.5deg 360deg), @var(--p); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--edge); clip-path: @var(--edge); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
